stem: Adil writes the place value of each digit in $3.74$ using powers of $10$.

parts.text: Which product correctly writes the place value of the digit $7$?
Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In $3.74$, the digit $7$ sits in the tenths place, one place right of ones, so its place value is $7 \times 10^{-1}$.

teacher.key_rationale: Places right of ones use negative powers of 10. Tenths is 10^{-1}; 10^1 is tens; 10^{-2} is the place of the 4.
